inventory_boundary.source_ref: raw/paper.pdf and paper-source/AI-rearrange.tex were read in full; the frozen source bundle has no supplement.
inventory_boundary.reason: All five figures were split into independently judgeable displayed series. No-display statements are either supporting evidence or source-parameter context. The private Zhuifeng implementation is absent and was not accessed.
inventory_boundary.next_action: Keep the W1 denominator fixed; W2 should discriminate the Fig. 4 intensity mismatch and execute Fig. 5(a) on paper-matched hardware.

acceptance_criteria: A clean-room reduced run executes GNN training, score-Hungarian decoding, and modified-auction decoding and returns finite maximum- and average-distance observables.
One P2WGS campaign emits separate finite phase- and intensity-continuity observables for iterations 3, 5, 8, and 10.
The attestation declares that paper scale was not executed and does not change scientific coverage or hide the unpublished trajectory-protocol gap.
Resolve the published 127x127 to 101x101 geometry without shape drift.
Freeze device, sample counts, graph backend, decoder, and loss settings before execution.
Judge paper-facing Euclidean maximum and average movement distances rather than internal ranking proxies.
Preserve N=10201, T=101, and iteration counts 3, 5, 8, and 10.
Evaluate phase and intensity continuity separately for every iteration count.
Test the published intensity scale and 3-to-5 improvement without source-pixel fitting.
Separate compute-bound plateaus from hardware-bound linear branches.
Generate every Fig. 5(b) curve from declared timing parameters.
Keep Fig. 5(a) uncovered until its four wall-clock series are measured independently on the paper's RTX 5090 hardware class.
